title: Karmayogi Bharat, OpenAI Partner to Train Indian Civil Servants in Artificial Intelligence
hook_text: OpenAI is training India's civil servants.
script:
Karmayogi Bharat partnered with OpenAI to train Indian civil servants in AI.
The state-run public governance platform is rolling out this curriculum for government officers across India.
Over seventeen million government employees are registered on the iGOT Karmayogi platform.
The training program aims to integrate machine learning models into daily public sector administration workflows.
This initiative follows previous digital governance drives launched by the union government to modernize bureaucracy.
Would you trust a government official using an algorithm to handle your paperwork?
